property_summary: After deploying C with owner=address(this) and betLimit=0, calling AdjustBetAmounts(1) sets betLimit to 1; then c.ethBalance() returns address(c).balance in P but address(c).balance - 1 in M, causing assertTrue(c.ethBalance() == address(c).balance) to pass on P and fail on M.
change_summary: Replace address(this).balance with address(this).balance - 1 to reduce returned balance by 1.
